additional_info.subject: 0476814 - ID0476814-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002644] Check on logs CRM:00472000545
additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
In the first attempt, the user was authenticating for outlet ID1. This is your CCS plug for this charger. However he was connecting the EV in the AC plug which is the ID3.
After the first failed attempt the charger struggles with OCPP connectivity and is not able to send and receive the OCPP messages in time to process correctly the charging request.
On the next attempt after rebooting, the user correctly authenticate in conector ID3 and start charging.
Indeed there is power delivery, however for a very short moment. From our side I don't see any fault or issue. Sometimes EVs have limit SOC defined and if the SOC is over the limit they end the session immediately after power delivery. I can't say for sure if this is the case since that information relies only in EV side.
I went to see if in the last week the charger did some successful charging session with AC plug and that's the case.
I don't see the need to do any intervention and if you agree I suggest to close this ticket.
I will wait for your feedback.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.
SI E CS SD L3
201, Avenida 25 de Abril
2845-547 Corroios, Portugal
